visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) In a warehouse-style supermarket, a man in a plain white t-shirt and black shorts browses the refrigerated section. He holds several boxes of Sous Vide Duck Breast with Orange Sauce. The lighting is bright and industrial. His expression is enthusiastic as he shows the items. (2) Close-up shot of the product box on a black countertop, followed by a layout of the contents: two vacuum-sealed duck breasts and four individual yellow sauce packets. The camera then focuses on the four-step cooking instructions printed on the side of the cardboard packaging. (3) The scene shifts to a home kitchen. The man pours cooking oil from a bottle into a white ceramic frying pan on a stove. He carefully places the two pieces of duck meat into the pan, reacting with humorous fear. (4) The duck breast is shown searing until the skin is deep golden brown. The man uses metal tongs to flip the meat. He then transfers it to a wooden cutting board and slices it into small, uniform cubes, showing the texture. (5) The cubes are returned to the pan. The man opens a sauce packet and pours yellow orange glaze over the meat, tossing it until thoroughly coated. The resulting dish is plated on a black ceramic dish, looking glossy and appetizing. (6) The man prepares a drink by squeezing fresh orange halves into a large glass pitcher. He adds a generous amount of ice cubes and then pours green tea from a bottle to fill the pitcher, stirring the mixture thoroughly. (7) A woman with long dark hair and the man stand together in the kitchen, holding the plate of duck. They use chopsticks to taste the meat. Later, a young boy joins them. They all smile and express great satisfaction.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy male narration in Traditional Chinese opens the video over upbeat, bouncy background music. The voice is enthusiastic with high pitch variability. Faint supermarket ambient noise can be heard beneath the dialogue as he discusses purchasing the duck breast. (2) A sharp ding sound effect marks the transition to showing product details. The BGM remains consistent, maintaining a moderate tempo around 120 BPM. The speaker's intensity increases as he lists the ingredients found inside the box. (3) The sound of liquid oil being poured into a pan is clearly audible, followed by a loud, high-frequency sizzling sound as the meat hits the hot surface. The man's voice shifts to a more playful tone with laughter. (4) A series of cartoonish sound effects accompany the man's physical reactions to the cooking process. Rhythmic, percussive clack sounds occur as he uses metal tongs. This is followed by a crisp, crunchy sound of a knife cutting through skin. (5) A distinct splash and slosh sound is heard as the orange sauce is poured onto the meat. The music swells slightly in volume, creating a sense of completion. The speaker's tone is now full of anticipation and positive valence. (6) Sounds of orange squeezing and the sharp clinking of ice cubes against glass are prominent. The pouring of the green tea creates a continuous bubbling sound. A female voice enters briefly, asking a question with a curious, rising intonation. (7) Multiple voices—male, female, and a child—overlap in a joyful chorus of approval. The child's voice is high-pitched and sweet. Several ding and sparkle sound effects emphasize their positive reactions. The music reaches a final peak before a hard cut.
